info.name: Moneybags - Complete API Workflows and Data Flow
info.description: Executable platform workflow plus namespaced detailed service suites. Run folders 00-05 in order for the deterministic cross-service scenario. Folder 90 contains destructive or service-specific exhaustive coverage and should be selected explicitly.

item.name: 00 - Platform readiness
item.description: Fail-fast checks for every service used by the executable data flow.

item.name: 01 - Seed data verification
item.description: Verifies Liquibase-owned product, deposit, and accounting fixtures before money movement.

exec: pm.test('seeded savings product is active', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.productCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('savingsProductCode')); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });
pm.test('product accepts the opening request', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().eligible).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('source account is funded and active', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(Number(b.balance.available)).to.be.above(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('transferAmount'))); });

pm.test('accounting chart contains the deposit liability GL', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); const rows = b.content || b; pm.expect(rows.some(x => x.glCode === 'CUSTOMER_DEPOSIT_LIABILITY')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 02 - Payment data flow: Deposit -> Payments -> Accounting -> Notification
item.description: Executes an idempotent book transfer and proves its effects in every participating service.

exec: pm.test('payment settles end to end', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('SETTLED'); pm.expect(b.accountingJournalNumber).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('customer history contains the workflow payment', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().content.some(x => x.paymentId === pm.collectionVariables.get('workflowPaymentId'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('source available balance decreased once', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const before = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('sourceBalanceBefore')); const amount = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('transferAmount')); const b = pm.response.json(); const now = Number(b.available ?? b.availableBalance); pm.expect(now).to.eql(before - amount); });

pm.test('target available balance increased once', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const before = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('targetBalanceBefore')); const amount = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('transferAmount')); const b = pm.response.json(); const now = Number(b.available ?? b.availableBalance); pm.expect(now).to.eql(before + amount); });

pm.test('journal is posted and balanced', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('POSTED'); pm.expect(Number(b.totalDebit)).to.eql(Number(b.totalCredit)); });
pm.test('posting lookup resolves the payment', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().journalNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('workflowJournalNumber')); });

item.description: Run the complete collection in order. It contains assertions for all 41 implemented Deposit Account controller endpoints plus health, seed-data, and workflow verification requests. The Liquibase testdata and postman contexts provide stable CASA and historical fixed-deposit scenarios. Internal /internal/v1 requests call serviceUrl directly because the gateway intentionally does not route them. Security is disabled by default for local development.

pm.test('Blocked seed is present', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().content.some(a => a.accountId === pm.collectionVariables.get('deposit_blockedAccountId'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Dormant account disallows payments', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.debitAllowed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.creditAllowed).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('Seeded CASA closure account is active with zero balance', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.accountId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('deposit_seedClosureAccountId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(Number(body.balance.ledger)).to.eql(0); });
